original.target_description: Published White (2008), Experiment 3, pp. 209–211 (PDF pp. 6–8), including Table 3 and Results. This experiment manipulates A+ instances (2 versus 6) and B− instances (2 versus 4 versus 6), with separate analyses of judgments of A and B and six within-task A-versus-B comparisons. The supplied description instead names high versus low prevalence of B and does not identify a unique outcome/test within Experiment 3.

notes: Fresh original-only blind validation. Verified supplied published article title, author, year, journal, and DOI against its first page. Source: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/followup_mac_ab130ecf76b690399aea6ae1.txt. The supplied p. 7 is printed p. 210, covering Experiment 3. A high/low B-prevalence manipulation is described for Experiments 1 and 2, whereas Experiment 3 varies B− frequency at three levels; Table 3 holds B+ frequency at 12 throughout. Consequently neither the particular dependent judgment nor a uniquely matching F test and p value can be established from the supplied study/outcome/page combination. No statistic was selected from the several candidate tests, and no generic study sample was substituted for a target-test analytic sample. The paper is available; locator insufficiency is the reason for null original values. Replication and narrative success were unassigned and were not inspected. Source version retained: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service.
